display_name: Mishnah Kinnim: bird offerings that became mixed, flew, or were offered without asking -- the whole tractate (three chapters, fifteen units in the standard numbering), as law the Mishnah states, with no claim that any of it can be practised today
citation: Mishnah, Seder Kodashim, Tractate Kinnim, chapters 1-3, in the standard numbering (4, 5 and 6 units) of the printed text as he.wikisource gives it; crosswalks to Maimonides' recension (5, 6, 5) and to Moshe Koppel's Seder Kinnim (4, 6, 6) are in the encoding's NOTES.md
authority: The Mishnah, redacted by Rabbi Judah ha-Nasi about 200 CE; the anonymous teachings and the named Tannaim (Rabbi Yose, Ben Azzai, Rabbi Yehoshua, Rabbi Shimon ben Akashya). Not the law of any state. Filed under subjects/religious/halakhah/, a grammar this subject proposes and that is not ruled (see ../../README.md).
extent: Offerings brought at the Temple in Jerusalem, which has not stood since 70 CE
in_force: no: the tractate's rules govern Temple offerings, which are not brought today; the encoding states them as the text and its commentators give them

source.provider: he.wikisource (Hebrew Wikisource), pages משנה קינים א-ג, ברטנורא על קינים א-ג, תפארת ישראל על קינים ג, רמב"ם הלכות פסולי המוקדשין ח
source.note: Read through the MediaWiki parse API with the commons source-fetcher User-Agent. Each deposited file records the page revision it came from. Sefaria answered both its API and its site with a Cloudflare human-verification challenge, recorded as a no and not worked around. Mechon Mamre's robots.txt reserves AI use ('Content-Signal: ai-train=no, use=reference') and disallows ClaudeBot; its text was read once for orientation and not deposited.

why_this_subject: Kinnim is the Mishnah's most mathematical tractate: its rules are counting problems, and 3:2's 'the majority is valid' was read by Moshe Koppel (Higayon 2, pp. 96-102; Seder Kinnim, 1998) and Philip Reiss (Torah u-Madda Journal 9, 2000) as the smallest majority of a subset-sum problem. Meng Wong asked on 2026-11-02 for a solo encoding informed by Reiss and by Koppel's writings, shaped so its treatments can be extracted to formal backends.
